description: Task note specification (single source of truth). Defines a structured note skeleton across all task lists: Scenario / Fixed Input / Conclusion / Boundary / Executable Answer / Test Archive / Correction. General principle: all engineering steps must leave traceable records in ADLM.
field:
item.comment (string). Rich text editor may produce HTML

...

; plain text paragraphs are equally valid.

required.purpose: Why this task exists and what fact it establishes; boundaries must be obvious at a glance.
Quantified verdict with numbers and qualifiers; no narrative GREEN statements without verifiable evidence.
Reproducible commands / script paths / path:line / hashes / raw server responses.
Primary anchor file + related file list, aligned with config/file-anchors.json.

recommended.purpose: Inputs, preconditions, and environments needed to reproduce the verdict; avoid guesswork.
What is out of scope, known divergences, differences between spec and implementation.
One-line reproduction command and exit code semantics.
Append a timestamped paragraph for each test run; never mutate or delete older logs.
Append when prior conclusions are overturned, stating why the old verdict is obsolete; never rewrite history silently.

commentPolicy.appendOnlyNote: Corrections and new test archives are always appended as standalone paragraphs without rewriting existing text; corrections must state why earlier verdicts became obsolete.

examTruth.requiredKeysNote: Strict three-in-one check gate; these three keys should be documented in the comment field of exam items.
examTruth.truthPolicy: Official specification text + SHA-256 deliverable checksum
examTruth.truthPolicyNote: Defined against the project's primary risk (silent spec/deliverable drift); override in config/site.json project.truthPolicy.
examTruth.separation: exam stores truth / tolerances / hashes only; test stores comparison logic and execution; test uses compares-to to reference exam. Never redefine truth constants in test code.

audit.systemFieldsNote: Populated by the server on state transitions; can be omitted in manually created seeds. statusHistory is bounded by lib/status.js STATUS_HISTORY_LIMIT — persistent audit trails rely on docs/records/ snapshots.
audit.snapshot: npm run snapshot records point-in-time snapshots of data/shared_lists/ and data/archive/ into docs/records/, which is intentionally tracked in version control.
